pc.botfather.title: Create a bot
pc.botfather.intro: Bots post in your groups and channels, answer /commands and show buttons people can tap. This takes about a minute.
pc.botfather.name_title: What should your bot be called?
pc.botfather.name_help: This is the name people see in groups and channels. You can change it later.
pc.botfather.username_help: People find and share your bot with it, like @weather_bot. It must end in “bot”.
pc.botfather.taken_try: Already taken. Try one of these:
pc.botfather.mine: This is already one of your bots
pc.botfather.unknown: Couldn't check right now. It will be checked when you save.
pc.botfather.profile_help: Pick a picture and write one line people read before adding it.
pc.botfather.commands_help: Commands appear when someone types / in a group. Tap a suggestion to add it, or start from a template.
pc.botfather.token_secret: Keep this token secret. Anyone who has it can post as your bot. If it leaks, revoke it in My bots.
pc.botfather.add_title: Add it to a group or channel
pc.botfather.add_help: Only groups and channels where you are an admin are listed. You can also do this later.
pc.botfather.add_none: You aren't an admin of any group or channel yet.
pc.bot.revoke_confirm: Create a new token? The old one stops working at once, so update your program.
pc.bot.username_rule: 5–32 characters: lowercase letters, digits and _, starting with a letter and ending in “bot”
pc.bot.about_hint: One line shown on the bot's profile (120 characters)
pc.bot.public_hint: Anyone can find this bot by its name or @username and add it to their groups.
pc.bot.link_needs_username: Choose a username to get a share link
pc.botprofile.not_found: This bot doesn't exist or isn't public
pc.botprofile.unreachable: Couldn't reach the OSHI server. Try again.
pc.botprofile.no_admin: You need to be an admin of a group or channel to add a bot.
pc.botprofile.permissions: What can this bot do here?
pc.botprofile.remote_group: This bot runs on its owner's server. It will see the commands and button taps in this group, not your conversation.
pc.botprofile.remote_channel: This bot runs on its owner's server. It will see the commands and button taps in this channel, not your conversation.
pc.botprofile.search_hint: Type @ and a name to find a public bot to add
